missing_or_extra: Extra: checks displayed product prices are monotonically ascending, normalized search query/scope, and browser profile/bookmark/extension footprint.
notes: Official accepts URL query S=4 + substrings or body text keywords without verifying displayed prices are actually ordered; blind spec's strict monotonic price check could reject valid sorted pages if Kohl's injects sponsored tiles.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves other Chrome profiles, non-name settings, bookmarks, history, passwords, and extensions.
notes: Both check that the active Chrome profile display name is updated to 'Thomas'.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires clearing all Amazon-owned domain/partition cookies plus persistent storage (localStorage/IndexedDB), sessionStorage, service workers, and CacheStorage, while preserving non-Amazon cookies.
notes: Official is_cookie_deleted only checks the SQLite Cookies table for host_key == '.amazon.com'. Requiring service workers/CacheStorage/sessionStorage to be cleared may reject a user who only deleted amazon.com cookies.

missing_or_extra: Different: evaluates dynamically against the live FlightAware General forum's current top-reply topic and normalizes Discourse thread URLs (allowing post-number suffixes), whereas official hardcodes a static URL.
notes: Blind spec is more faithful to the instruction because live forum reply counts can change over time and Discourse appends /<post_number> to the URL when viewing or scrolling a thread.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves non-Safe-Browsing preferences, bookmarks, history, extensions, and cookies.
notes: Both check that Chrome Safe Browsing (safebrowsing.enabled) is turned on.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves non-Do-Not-Track preferences, bookmarks, history, extensions, and cookies.
notes: Both check that enable_do_not_track is enabled in Chrome Preferences.

missing_or_extra: Different: checks that left-side docks are hidden/closed while requiring right-side docks to remain in their initial state; official checks sessionrc for (hide-docks yes), which hides all docks globally.
notes: The prompt is internally ambiguous ('remove the dock on the left side ... leaving only the image space'): blind spec is more faithful to removing only the left dock, whereas official requires GIMP's global Tab hide-docks toggle.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires yellow triangle bounding-box center within 1px of canvas center (vs. official 5% canvas dimension tolerance on contour centroid) plus exact pixel preservation of the triangle and other canvas objects.
notes: Preserving other objects and triangle geometry is reasonable and catches collateral edits, but 1px tolerance (and bounding-box center vs. polygon centroid) would wrongly reject valid manual drag-to-center solutions.

missing_or_extra: Missing: does not check visual/structural similarity (SSIM >= 0.9) of the active indexed image against the original image; Extra: checks open image and desktop file footprint.
notes: Official exports palette_computer.png and checks both mode == 'P' and RGB-converted SSIM >= 0.9 against computer.png; blind spec only checks base_color_mode == 'indexed', palette size 1..256, and canvas dimensions.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks text layer moved left, bounding-box center_x < canvas.width / 2, full text box inside canvas, text/style unchanged, and non-text layers unchanged (fuzzy aesthetic clause not credited).
notes: Official check_textbox_on_leftside only checks that the left-most dark pixel in the upper half is at x < 0.35 * width without verifying text preservation or background integrity. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves all gimprc settings except undo-levels and keeps open images unchanged.
notes: Both check that undo-levels is set to 100 in GIMP configuration.

missing_or_extra: Missing: code-checkable must block omits Hue and Value channel structural similarity (SSIM >= 0.9) against the original image, relegating content/structure preservation to an uncredited fuzzy clause.
notes: Official check_saturation_increase_and_structure_sim checks both mean HSV saturation increase and H/V channel SSIM >= 0.9; blind spec's deterministic must only checks canvas size, mean HSV saturation increase, and alpha channel.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves all cell styles in addition to non-title cell values and sheet structure.
notes: Both check that movie title cells are trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, and converted to Proper Case while keeping other cell values intact.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks chart x-axis categories (specifically that Jan is omitted from the Growth line chart), chart series values, and percentage number format on the Growth row, plus original cell preservation.
notes: Official compare_table only checks sheet_data and chart_props ['type', 'title'], never verifying what data or months the charts actually plot. Blind spec's chart series/category checks are much better; requiring % number format is slightly stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra: directly verifies the new Revenue column formula/values on Sheet1 in addition to the Sheet2 product revenue pivot table and Retail Price sheet preservation.
notes: Official compare_table checks the Sheet2 pivot table and preserves Sheet1 A1:F36 and Retail Price, but never directly inspects Column G (Revenue) on Sheet1. Blind spec is reasonably stricter and more complete.

missing_or_extra: None: both check Sheet2 headers ('Total Revenue', 'Total Expenses') and sums in A1:B2 plus preservation of Sheet1.
notes: Blind spec matches the gold workbook check and Sheet1 preservation rule.

missing_or_extra: None: both check Sheet2 Column A contains the 'Revenue' header and copied Revenue values from Sheet1 with Sheet1 preserved.
notes: Blind spec matches the gold workbook check and Sheet1 preservation rule.

missing_or_extra: Different: requires hiding N/A values at the cell display level (invisible text/custom format) while keeping row visibility unchanged; official checks row_props ['hidden'] against gold file where N/A rows are hidden.
notes: Official interpretation (hiding the rows containing N/A) is more faithful to standard spreadsheet usage and explains why the prompt says 'Notice the N/A entries in rows? ... filter is not needed'.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires auto_save.enabled == true AND save_original_document_automatically (UserAutoSave) == true in addition to AutoSaveTimeIntervall == 3, plus config footprint.
notes: Official check_auto_saving_time only checks AutoSaveTimeIntervall == 3 in registrymodifications.xcu. Requiring save_original_document_automatically would wrongly reject standard solutions that only enable AutoRecovery every 3 minutes.

missing_or_extra: Missing: checks only has_visible_bullet == true on current slide body paragraphs without checking bullet character (buChar) or indentation level (lvl == 0) enforced by the 4 official gold files.
notes: Official compare_pptx_files checks exact bullet character and level against 4 gold variants plus all slide/shape/font properties; blind spec accepts any visible bullet glyph or level.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves picture image SHA-256 hashes and picture position fields in addition to non-picture shapes and other slides.
notes: Both check that picture heights on slides 3, 4, and 6 are 20, 30, and 25 cm (allowing proportional width changes if aspect ratio is locked).

missing_or_extra: None: both check single strikethrough on lines 1 and 2 of the to-do list on the active slide (Slide 5) while preserving all text, other lines, font styles, and other slides.
notes: Setup navigates down 4 slides to Slide 5 before the agent acts; blind spec's before(current_slide) resolves to Slide 5, matching the official gold files.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires libreoffice.impress.current_slide_index == 5 in the open UI and requires empty paragraphs' default font color on Slide 5 to also be #FFFF00.
notes: Official compare_pptx_files only checks the saved .pptx file's non-empty text runs on Slide 5. Checking current_slide_index == 5 is reasonable, but checking empty paragraph default colors could wrongly reject valid solutions.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that slides 2..N keep their original transitions and preserves all slide count, order, text, and shapes.
notes: Official check_transition only checks that slide 1 XML has <p:dissolve/>, ignoring whether the transition was mistakenly applied to all slides or whether slide content was altered.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks rendered_page_count increased by 1, the page immediately after the starting cursor page has zero visible body content, and all existing content/pages before and after are preserved.
notes: Official contains_page_break only checks that the total count of <w:br w:type='page'/> elements anywhere in the document equals 5, without checking location, blankness, or text deletion.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks lowercase conversion across all editable text stories (including tables) and requires all character/paragraph formatting and non-text elements to be preserved.
notes: Official compare_docx_files only compares top-level paragraph text strings against the gold .docx and ignores formatting destruction. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Missing: allows soft line breaks or paragraph spacing that produce one empty rendered line instead of requiring explicit empty paragraphs ('') between sentences, and delegates abbreviation period disambiguation to an uncredited fuzzy clause.
notes: Official compare_docx_files(ignore_blanks=False) against 4 gold files requires empty paragraphs between split sentences; blind spec's footprint adds formatting preservation.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the new 5x7 empty table is anchored at the starting cursor position and that all original document text and formatting are preserved.
notes: Official compare_docx_tables only checks doc.tables (1 table of 5 rows x 7 cols with empty cells) and completely ignores table placement in the body and whether document text was deleted.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the original comma-delimited paragraphs were removed (no duplicate source text left behind) and that all document content outside the converted block is preserved.
notes: Official compare_docx_tables only checks doc.tables cell values against 2 gold files and ignores whether the raw comma-separated paragraphs remain duplicated in the body or other text was deleted.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves non-highlight character and paragraph formatting in addition to all document text.
notes: Both check that all character highlight is removed in sample-recruitment-phone-script.odt and that all text content is preserved.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks system.boot_id is unchanged and all other running GUI applications keep their original PIDs ('without losing my work in other apps').
notes: Official only checks that no soffice process is running and ~/.bash_history contains 'kill'. Blind spec reasonably verifies that other open apps were not killed.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: checks local Meeting-Agenda.docx and other Google Drive items are unchanged.
notes: Both check that /meetings/Meeting-Agenda.pdf exists in Google Drive with matching page count and text/visual content.

missing_or_extra: Unverifiable: delegates functional correctness of completed calculator.py functions and expected log.txt output values to a prose fuzzy clause and uses an undefined ast.unfinished_function_markers heuristic.
notes: Official compares /home/user/Desktop/log.txt against log_Gold.txt. Because calculator.py is inside a remote zip, the blind spec's deterministic must only checks exit_code == 0 and non-empty stdout copied to log.txt.

missing_or_extra: Unverifiable: delegates the 'warmest to coolest' strip ordering to a prose fuzzy clause (must accepts any of the 6 permutations) and uses a vague terminal.command_history.any_Matches(kind=...) predicate.
notes: Official checks SSIM >= 0.9 against rearranged_gold.png without checking CLI usage. Blind spec cannot deterministically verify which permutation is warmest-to-coolest as written.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the unpacked extension is enabled (enabled == true), Chrome developer_mode == true, and extension source files on Desktop are unmodified.
notes: Official only checks that /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension appears in installed unpacked extension paths in Preferences. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that colliding with food actually consumes the food, increments snake length by 1, spawns replacement food on the grid, preserves normal movement, and starts cleanly.
notes: Official test.py returns True the instant snake.positions[0] == food.position (only testing coordinate alignment without checking if the snake grows or food respawns). Blind spec is much more complete.

missing_or_extra: Unverifiable: relies on an unimplementable receipts('...').extracted_transactions.as_rows(...) OCR/semantic reader plus a fuzzy clause to extract fields and infer unprinted expense categories from 5 receipt images.
notes: Official compare_table checks A1:E13 against my_bookkeeping_gold.xlsx. Extracting structured rows and inferring categories from raw receipt images is the task itself, not a deterministic code check.

missing_or_extra: Missing: accepts any web search engine results page for cell B6's value ('nereida') instead of requiring Google (https://www.google.com/search?q=nereida.*); Extra: preserves cell_search.xls.
notes: Official is_expected_search_query hardcodes Google Search URL matching, whereas the prompt only asks to 'search it in Chrome' (Chrome opens without Google as an active tab).

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires /home/user/instructor-embedding to exist as a valid git clone of https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding and pip check to pass, in addition to importing INSTRUCTOR (fuzzy Colab clause not credited).
notes: Official only runs python -c 'from InstructorEmbedding import INSTRUCTOR;' in the default shell without checking if /home/user/instructor-embedding exists. Checking the repo clone is reasonable; pip check could fail on pre-existing VM conflicts.

missing_or_extra: Missing: accepts any whole-document concatenation order of the PDF attachments from 'Paper Recommendation', whereas official compare_pdfs against attachment_full_gold.pdf enforces one fixed attachment order.
notes: Because the prompt does not specify an attachment merge order, the blind spec's permutation-tolerant check is arguably fairer, and its footprint checks Thunderbird message preservation.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks desktop default video app is VLC, video/mp4 default is vlc.desktop, and all video MIME types previously assigned to the default player resolve to vlc.desktop, plus non-video MIME footprint.
notes: Official get_default_video_player only queries xdg-mime default for video/x-matroska. Blind spec is reasonably stricter and matches what Ubuntu's Default Applications GUI sets.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that every occurrence of 'Iliad' (and no other text) is highlighted, that consecutive Gemini responses have 1 empty rendered line between them, and that llm_answers.json is unmodified.
notes: Official compare_docx_files_and_ignore_new_lines strips blank paragraphs, collapses whitespace, and completely ignores highlighting (compare_highlighted_text was deprecated). Blind spec is much more faithful to the prompt.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves non-notification GNOME settings and running applications.
notes: Both check that org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners is set to false (Do Not Disturb mode).

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks SHA-256 content hashes of all copied .jpg files in cpjpg, verifies no non-.jpg files were placed in cpjpg, and verifies the source /home/user/Desktop/photos tree was not modified or deleted.
notes: Official check_moved_jpgs only checks that the 4 expected filenames exist in cpjpg (ignoring file contents and accepting mv instead of cp). Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: checks that regular file SHA-256 contents, directory permission bits (e.g. preserving +x traversal bits), and symlinks under the directory tree are unchanged.
notes: Both check that all regular files under the starting working directory tree have mode 0644.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires text-scaling-factor >= 1.25 (Ubuntu Large Text toggle) and forbids enabling the GNOME screen magnifier (which the official 'or' evaluator accepts alongside text-scaling-factor >= 1.2).
notes: Rejecting full-screen magnifier is arguably more faithful to 'enlarge the text', but requiring >= 1.25 would reject valid custom text-scaling factors like 1.15 or 1.2.

missing_or_extra: Different: requires OpenSSH chroot confinement (ChrootDirectory /home/test1 so charles cannot access paths outside /home/test1), whereas official checks /etc/passwd home dir == /home/test1 and owner write permission on /home/test1.
notes: In OpenSSH, ChrootDirectory requires /home/test1 to be owned by root and not writable by charles, making the two checks incompatible. Blind spec is more faithful to 'only allowed to access the folder /home/test1'.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks desktop application registration, executable launch target resolution, and a startup probe verifying Spotify launches without missing shared library errors.
notes: Official only checks that 'which spotify' output contains 'spotify'. Blind spec reasonably catches broken installs or dummy executables on PATH.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks auto_quote == false across all active identities AND verifies via reply_preview that replying to an inbox message does not insert a quoted body, plus account/message footprint.
notes: Official only checks mail.identity.id1.auto_quote == false in prefs.js. Blind spec is reasonably stricter (assuming a single active identity or uniform preference across active identities).

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: checks that remote mail server settings are untouched, no existing emails were forwarded/sent, and existing folders/messages are unchanged.
notes: Both check that an enabled incoming filter rule on anonym-x2024@outlook.com matches all messages and forwards them to anonym-x2024@gmail.com.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the attached aws-bill.pdf matches /home/user/aws-bill.pdf by SHA-256, that sender/recipients/subject/body in the compose window are unchanged, and that no message was sent.
notes: Official AT-SPI script only checks that 'aws-bill.pdf' is listed in the open 'Write: New-month AWS Bill' window's attachment pane. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra: verifies the actual password field value ('password'), that account setup is not completed, and that no new persisted account was created.
notes: Official check_accessibility_tree only checks for an element named 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com' and an element whose name contains 'password'/'Password' (which matches the empty password field label without checking the typed password!).

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves message contents, non-star flags, and all folders outside Bills.
notes: Both check that all original messages in the local Bills folder remain present and starred.

missing_or_extra: Missing: checks mail.server.default.applyIncomingFilters == true but omits mail.imap.use_status_for_biff == false (and mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores != false) required by the official checker.
notes: Official check_thunderbird_prefs requires both applyIncomingFilters == true and mail.imap.use_status_for_biff == false so Thunderbird checks non-Inbox IMAP folders for incoming filter execution.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the configured global-key-play-pause has no desktop shortcut conflicts and passes a behavioral hotkey_probe toggling VLC while the PDF reader stays focused in the foreground.
notes: Official only checks that global-key-play-pause is non-empty in vlcrc after restarting VLC. Blind spec reasonably verifies that the global shortcut actually works while the PDF reader is focused.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves the source video file and other files on Desktop.
notes: Both check that /home/user/Desktop/interstellar.png matches the paused VLC video frame.

missing_or_extra: Extra: requires maximum_relative_luminance < 0.08 (approx sRGB <= 79), maximum_oklab_chroma < 0.10 (near-neutral/achromatic), and value != before (fuzzy visual clause not credited).
notes: Official check_qt_slider_colours only checks that all 12 RGB integers are < 100, which accepts saturated dark colors like (99,0,0). Requiring low chroma is better; luminance < 0.08 is slightly stricter than RGB < 100.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves all vlcrc settings except qt-max-volume.
notes: Both check that qt-max-volume is set to 200 in VLC configuration.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: preserves the source video file and unrelated desktop settings.
notes: Both check that the persisted desktop wallpaper image matches the current paused VLC video frame.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that VLC is in windowed mode (not fullscreen), bottom playback controls are hidden, and a restart application_probe confirms VLC reopens in windowed minimal-interface mode.
notes: Official only checks qt-minimal-view=1 in vlcrc and never checks the prompt's 'in window mode, rather than full-screen' requirement. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks effective setting, a runtime debug_probe verifying focus remains on the Debug Console on breakpoint hit, and preservation of all other settings and workspace files.
notes: Official check_json_settings only checks user settings.json for 'debug.focusEditorOnBreak': false. Blind spec is reasonably stricter.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: checks extension is enabled in the current profile and preserves previously installed extensions and user settings.
notes: Both check that ms-python.python is installed in VS Code.

missing_or_extra: Extra: checks that the active VS Code window's workspace root is specifically '/home/user/project', shown in Explorer, and that all files inside /home/user/project are unmodified.
notes: Official OpenProject check uses compare_config with containment_ok=True to check only whether the substring 'project' appears in /home/user/OpenProject.txt. Blind spec is much more accurate.

missing_or_extra: Different: checks semantically that ctrl+f in Explorer tree focus does not invoke list.find while preserving ctrl+f in editorTextFocus; official checks keybindings.json for one exact literal dict with when == 'listFocus && listSupportsFind'.
notes: Blind spec is more faithful to the instruction because valid keybinding removals can use other or omitted when clauses, while official fails to check if editor ctrl+f was broken.

missing_or_extra: Different: checks canonical resolved folder paths set_equal ['/home/user/project', '/home/user/data1', '/home/user/data2'] in both project.code-workspace and the active window; official requires exact ordered relative paths ['project', 'data1', 'data2'].
notes: Blind spec is more faithful to the instruction, which specifies absolute paths ('/home/user/data1' and '/home/user/data2') and does not mandate relative path strings or folder order.

missing_or_extra: Extra footprint only: checks extension is enabled in the current profile and preserves previously installed extensions and user settings.
notes: Both check that njpwerner.autodocstring is installed in VS Code.
